question_text: Write an ANSI SQL query to compute customer LTV, order frequency, and AOV from `customer_purchases_1`.
correct_answer:
SELECT customer_id,
       SUM(amount) AS total_lifetime_value,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS aov
FROM customer_purchases_1
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_lifetime_value DESC;
answer_explanation: Aggregates customer lifetime value (LTV), total purchase count, and average order value (AOV).
